items.quote: I hear this a lot. And I used to agree… until I started actually listening to my own calls, back in 2016 when I was selling myself.
items.statement: I used to agree that scripts don’t work.

items.quote: A good script isn’t a robotic checklist. It’s a navigation system.
items.statement: A good script isn’t a robotic checklist; it’s a navigation system.

items.quote: It gives you structure, language, and confidence — without taking away your personality.
items.statement: Scripts provide structure, language, and confidence without taking away personality.

items.quote: So I’ve added my full script — the one I use in my trainings — to the link in my profile.
items.statement: I’ve added my full script — the one I use in my trainings — to the link in my profile.

items.quote: Download it, test it, and see what happens when you stop guessing.
items.statement: Test the script and see what happens when you stop guessing.

overview: LinkedIn post discussing the effectiveness of scripts in sales.
